page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-144-lssd is a high-density compute instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 144 virtual CPUs across 72 dedicated physical cores using the Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor running at a clock speed of 2.3 GHz. Memory allocation totals 540 GB, translating to 3.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. The hardware subsystem includes 504 MB of Level 3 cache and vector acceleration instructions including Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512. The configuration includes no discrete GPUs.

Local I/O capability is a primary characteristic of this server, which bundles 9,648 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD storage distributed over 24 local drives. This integrated storage layout yields fast, low-latency read and write performance directly on the host, avoiding network storage latency for high-throughput data pipelines. The instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, aligning with private VPC architectures.

Empirical benchmarks demonstrate top-tier execution across multi-threaded and memory-intensive evaluations. The instance recorded a multi-core Geekbench score of 21,445.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 134,831.3. Large-block memory tests yielded 534.35 GB/sec in read bandwidth and 205.75 GB/sec in write bandwidth. Database benchmarks and in-memory key-value tests reflect high scale, reaching 35,667.37 operations in PassMark database tests and over 207 million operations per second in Redis SET operations. Conversely, single-core metrics fall into median percentiles as expected from the 2.3 GHz baseline clock speed.

In terms of qualitative cost efficiency, the instance provides high compute and local storage density within a single node, reducing distributed cluster management overhead. Workloads bound by single-thread frequency or requiring dedicated GPU accelerators will face architectural limitations on this machine. The c4-standard-144-lssd is engineered for high-concurrency relational and NoSQL database management systems, in-memory caching arrays, large-scale CI/CD build environments, data extraction and transformation pipelines, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-144-lssd is a high-capacity compute instance equipped with 144 vCPUs and 72 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor clocked at 2.3 GHz. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, it integrates 504 MB of L3 cache, AMX, and AVX-512 instruction extensions. System memory totals 540 GB, providing 3.75 GB per vCPU, coupled with 9,648 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage across 24 drives. It contains no discrete GPUs. Benchmark results place the instance in the top tier for multi-core compute, large-block memory bandwidth, static web throughput, and database transaction rates, while single-thread performance remains within average tiers. The bundled NVMe array and high core count make it structurally suited for I/O-intensive database engines, in-memory data stores, distributed compilation tasks, and parallel data analysis pipelines.
